purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public map/service routes, bounded anonymous access review, and evidence limits.
assessment: Huế's official GIS host exposes an anonymous ArcGIS FeatureServer layer named coCauPhanLo_update. The layer returns polygon geometry and native OID fid, but its name and attributes describe planned subdivision/plot structure rather than cadastral registration. Three bounded geometries were retained with only canonical id properties.
registryAssessment: Official Huế procedure pages evidence a local land-information service/procedure, while the public GIS layer is not enough to prove a cadastral registry feed. registryFound is therefore null.

queries.query: Hue Vietnam official cadastral parcel map GIS land registration natural resources public map
queries.outcome: Official Huế GIS viewer, land-data procedure, and planning map found; no public cadastral schema was evidenced.

queries.query: Huế bản đồ địa chính thửa đất GIS đăng ký đất đai Sở Tài nguyên và Môi trường chính thức
queries.outcome: Nguồn chính thức xác nhận thủ tục cung cấp dữ liệu đất đai và GIS Huế; chưa chứng minh lớp phân lô công khai là cơ sở dữ liệu địa chính.

attempts.result: Anonymous ArcGIS directory loaded; Hosted folder listed.
Service metadata loaded: 1 polygon layer, maxRecordCount 2000, query capability, 314-record layer extent, EPSG:3857.

Schema loaded; native objectIdField is fid. Native source fields include objectid, mahoso, dientich, kyhieuloda, solo, trangthaiq, madoituong, manhandang and planning/building fields. No owner/address/title fields requested or retained.
Bounded where=1=1 query requested only fid and geometry, resultRecordCount=3, outSR=4326; three safe polygons returned and retained in hu-parcel-samples.geojson.
Exact WUP-point intersects query returned zero features; no coordinate shift was made and no absence inference was drawn.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Zero exact-point hit; this is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.

remainingUncertainty: The layer's cadastral status, business identity semantics, citywide coverage, current viewer configuration, and any separate land-registration service remain unverified.
runtimeAssessment: held; serial reviewer must independently qualify any cadastral adapter
